comment: Surface keys with no keyless scenario yet. Every entry states why it is uncovered and the exit condition that removes it; `npm run check` fails when a new key appears without a scenario or a debt entry, and when an entry goes stale.

entries.reason: The route hands a registered file to the host native file browser. The keyless lane must not drive a user-visible desktop action, and the host session controller has no injectable opener in that lane.
entries.exitCondition: A host-level injectable opener (or a consenting desktop lane) must exist before this route can be asserted headlessly; then delete this entry.
